create_wav2vec2_phoneme_tokenizer: create a Wav2Vec2PhonemeCTCTokenizer instance from a vocab file with phonemization enabled
build_phonemized_text: build phonemized text from plain English input using the phonemizer backend
decode_ctc_token_ids: decode a list of CTC token IDs into a transcribed string with optional character offsets
batch_decode_sequences: batch decode multiple CTC token ID sequences into transcribed strings with optional character offsets
save_tokenizer_vocabulary: save the tokenizer vocabulary to a directory as a JSON file
